Join the 4M Crew

At 4M, we're building smarter infrastructure - starting with the data no one sees but everyone depends on. That's why we’re looking for curious, driven individuals ready to change how the world is built. If that sounds like you, we want you on our team.

4M Perks

Empowering you to do your best work

We want 4M to be a place where you do great work—and feel great doing it.

Hybrid Work Model

Blending on-site collaboration and remote work for IL and Austin teams, with full remote flexibility for U.S. employees outside Austin.

Competitive Equity Plan

We offer stock options so every team member shares in the company’s long-term success.

Retirement Benefits

Social contributions, including 401(k) company match to help you build a strong financial future.

Flexible PTO Policy

We believe in balance - take time off when you need it. And with extended parental leave, you can be fully present for life’s most important moments.

Health and Wellness

Comprehensive coverage to support your physical and mental well-being, every step of the way.

Events and Celebrations

From team outings to holiday parties and SKO events, we take the time to connect, have fun, and celebrate milestones together.

Core Values

Our shared values provide the blueprint to success.

People First

Our company is a reflection of the unique people who shape it. We treat each other as humans - not resources - and foster a culture where care and inclusion come first, where individuals feel supported and empowered to thrive.

Mission-Driven

Guided by our mission, we listen closely, build trust, and push boundaries to create significant value for our customers. We strive to solve real problems, exceed expectations, and support each other in shaping meaningful change.

Taking Ownership, Staying Accountable

At 4M, each of us shows up - taking ownership, following through on commitments, standing behind our words, and proactively driving results - playing a key role in moving the company forward. That’s how we create collective impact.

Curious, Bold & Adaptable

We embrace the journey we're part of: We stay curious, learn constantly, adapt fast, and take bold risks to grow through uncertainty and build what’s never been built.

Build to Scale

At 4M, scale isn’t a milestone - it’s how we deliver on our mission. We build with scale in mind from day one: Moving with intention, embracing operational excellence, and leveraging technology, data, and thoughtful trade-offs to create lasting impact. If it’s not scalable, it’s not an option.
